'''Dr. Henry Jacala Ramos''' (July 15, 1950 - March 11, 2024) was a professor emeritus of [[Physics]]<ref>{{cite web |title=National Institute of Physics – College of Science, University of the Philippines, Diliman, Quezon City |url=http://nip.upd.edu.ph/ |access-date=13 September 2021}}</ref><ref>Technology Management Center [[UP Diliman]]. (2016, February 29). [http://www.tmc.upd.edu.ph/?p=336 Dr. Henry J. Ramos is now a Professor Emeritus]. ''TMC UP Diliman''</ref> at the [[University of the Philippines Diliman]] and the first [[Filipino people|Filipino]] experimental [[Plasma (physics)|plasma]] [[physicist]]. He was the founder of the [https://web.archive.org/web/20101108200221/http://www.nip.upd.edu.ph/plasma/ Plasma Physics Laboratory], [[National Institute of Physics]], [[UP Diliman College of Science]].<ref>Department of Science and Technology. (2008, April–June). [http://sntpost.stii.dost.gov.ph/NewPOST/AprJun2008/sciencescholars/Dr_Henry_Ramos.htm Science Scholars: Dr. Henry J. Ramos] {{Webarchive|url=https://web.archive.org/web/20150109161503/http://sntpost.stii.dost.gov.ph/NewPOST/AprJun2008/sciencescholars/Dr_Henry_Ramos.htm |date=2015-01-09 }}. ''Science and Technology Post''</ref>

His work on formation of [[titanium nitride]] films received patents from the [[United States]],<ref>Ramos, H. J. (2005) ''[http://www.freepatentsonline.com/20050126903.pdf U.S. Patent No. 2005/0126903 A1]''. Washington, DC: U.S. Patent and Trademark Office.</ref><ref>Ramos, H. J. (2008). [https://docs.google.com/viewer?url=patentimages.storage.googleapis.com/pdfs/US7438955.pdf ''U.S. Patent No. 7438955 B2'']. Washington, DC: U.S. Patent and Trademark Office.</ref> [[Philippines]],<ref>Bantigue, A. M. B. (2014, April 4). [http://www.ovcrd.upd.edu.ph/blog/2014/04/04/a-milestone-in-technology-transfer-up-diliman-launches-coatin-the-first-and-only-local-tin-coating-technology-to-serve-commercial-sector/ A milestone in technology transfer: UP Diliman launches CoaTiN®, the first and only local TiN coating technology to serve commercial sector]. ''Office of the Vice Chancellor for Research & Development (OVCRD) – University of the Philippines Diliman''</ref><ref>Icamina, P. M. (2014, June 1). [http://newsbytes.ph/2014/06/01/up-prof-develops-coating-for-aerospace-semicon-tools/ UP prof develops coating for aerospace, semicon tools]. ''Newsbytes.PH''</ref> [[Malaysia]], [[Germany]], [[Sweden]], [[Taiwan]], [[Japan]], [[Singapore]] and [[China]].
